characterization_methods: Multiple internal reflection Fourier transform infrared (MIR-FTIR) spectroscopy
evidence: The quality of SAM formation and subsequent ALD reaction was examined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS), infrared spectroscopy, contact angle, and ellipsometry. Some of the ODTS SAMs were characterized using multiple internal reflection Fourier transform infrared (MIRFTIR) spectroscopy. The thickness of the precursor film was measured and averaged over several spots on each sample by ellipsometry, assuming a refractive index of n ) 1.46. The hydrophobicity of the precursor film was measured by average water contact angle. The results of the ALD process were examined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) at a detection limit of 0.5 atom %. Vibrational measurements using multiple internal reflection infrared (MIR-FTIR) spectroscopy on the vapor-formed SAMs.
